scope.summary: Implement seamless genital skin blending (spec 13.21/13.22 boundary; REQ-033, PREQ-010): the genital UDIM tile blends automatically with body skin - albedo/normal sampled from the body across the boundary band and genital maps re-derived - proven across ALL skin tones including dark skins, with the GENITAL_BLEND_VALID descriptor registered.
acceptance_criteria: The genital UDIM tile (MT-562 layout) maintains boundary continuity with the torso tile: an automatic blend band samples body albedo/normal across the boundary and re-derives genital-region maps so no visible seam remains.

Tone sweep: the blend is verified across the documented skin-tone set including dark tones (melanin range from MT-565) - the Golden Palace works-on-white-skins-only shell failure is the explicit anti-pattern; per-tone captures prove the result.
Blending runs automatically on skin bake with no manual texture matching, and re-runs on tone or texture-stack change.
GENITAL_BLEND_VALID descriptor registered per 13.15, emitting per-tone pass/fail with Argus capture refs.
scope.risk_if_missed: Golden Palace's shell blending famously works on white skins and fails on dark tones - a documented ecosystem complaint (REQ-033); shipping a blend not proven across all tones repeats that failure and blocks GENITAL_BLEND_VALID for a whole class of bodies.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit genital anatomy and controls

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
